errors.source_evidence: A large photograph of a smiling woman at a table with plants fills the lower half of the page (about y=1080–1845), below the Bottom Line callout.
errors.html_evidence: The photograph is missing from the render. Only a small text caption ("Photograph: a smiling woman with glasses...") appears in its place, leaving a large blank area.
errors.correction: Include the actual photograph as an img element at full content width below the callout, with the descriptive text as alt text or a figcaption, not as a substitute for the image.

errors.source_evidence: The hero banner has a photographic background of a green plant wall and office. The quote text sits on it, and the banner has a thin vertical divider between each pair of quotes.
errors.html_evidence: The hero is a flat dark green block with no background image. There are no vertical dividers between the quotes.
errors.correction: Add the plant-wall background image to the hero with a dark overlay, and add thin vertical divider lines between the three quotes.

errors.source_evidence: The "THE BOTTOM LINE" heading has a yellow bracket-style border tab connected to the callout box, and a yellow-to-teal gradient bar runs down the left page edge.
errors.html_evidence: The heading is plain text. The callout is a fully closed yellow rectangle, and there is no left-edge gradient bar.
errors.correction: Reproduce the yellow tab outline joined to the callout, which extends to the right page edge, and add the vertical gradient strip on the left edge.
